seed.scope: Only particles physically inside the historical cup are reused as a calibration initializer. This is not a new task success; no escaped particles enter the new cup. Initial velocities are zero, followed by native settling.

scope: Three stable low-level pilots plus 48 stationary settled-seed initializations, 12 training and four validation layouts. No FN30 autonomous development/test images.
